controls.reason: A role table cannot prove that its named actors have real legal and organizational authority over holds. Therefore the proposed deterministic composite does not prove the whole rule “Define who can issue, approve, modify, release, and audit a legal or investigative hold.”.

controls.reason: Source time-zone and clock metadata are exact typed values within a sealed item manifest. This proves the complete bounded meaning of “Preserve source time-zone and clock information.”.
